items.detail: Courts may order disclosure if the interest in the information outweighs any prejudice, as per the Supreme Court of Canada in *Lac d'Amiante du Québec Ltée v. 2858-0702 Québec Inc.*.

items.detail: The court may require disclosure of financial or personal information if it is necessary to ensure the child's well-being or support, as per the Divorce Act and Family Law Act.

items.detail: Certain health or personal information may be exempt from disclosure under the Health Information Privacy and Management Act, such as information collected for quality improvement or in contemplation of legal proceedings.

items.detail: Courts may override privacy exemptions if the information is essential to the child's well-being or the fair resolution of the case, as per *Lac d'Amiante du Québec Ltée v. 2858-0702 Québec Inc.*.
